ZipBombValidator sums central-directory declared sizes via by_index_raw and checks max_archive_size each entry. Nonzero uncompressed + zero compressed -> infinite ratio refusal; zero/zero empty member skips that branch. Whole-archive ratio checked only when total compressed >0.
SecurityBudget built from config.security_limits; with_defaults() (fixed default limits) used by the PPTX OMML sub-parse.
PPTX: only entry count + ZipBombValidator at open; MAX_PPTX_MEMBER_SIZE = 100 MiB take() with no per-member declared-size precheck.
